name: league-coach
description: Personal post-game League of Legends coach: match review, mistake timeline and role finder.

scripts.dev: npm run build:main && npm run ensure-electron && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run ensure-electron && electron .
